titles: 11만 명 일하던 구로공단, 3만 명까지 무너지고도 디트로이트가 되지 않은 진짜 이유
공장이 떠난 디트로이트는 파산했고, 구로공단은 다시 찼다… 두 땅이 갈린 진짜 이유
"공장은 다 떠났는데" 구로공단이 디트로이트가 되지 않은 진짜 이유

image_concepts.A: 한국 주인공 대비 — 화면 3분의 2에 가산디지털단지 빌딩 앞 커피 들고 웃으며 출근하는 직장인들 + 태극기, 왼쪽 가장자리에 철거 중인 디트로이트 벽돌 공장·작은 성조기
image_concepts.B: 한 장면 대비 — 같은 땅의 낡은 붉은 벽돌 공장과 그 뒤로 솟은 유리 지식산업센터, 사이를 지나는 출근 인파

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한국 주인공 대비(2026-10-25 규칙). 화면 오른쪽 3분의 2를 가산디지털단지 유리 빌딩·역 출구 앞에서 커피를 들고 웃으며 출근하는 직장인들이 크게 차지하고, 왼쪽 3분의 1에 철거 장비에 뜯기는 디트로이트 벽돌 자동차 공장. 가운데 큰 인물 없음.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic epic cinematic Korean-hero contrast composition, gritty high-clarity HDR photo with heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain and fine noise, crisp detailed textures on metal, glass and brick. The right two-thirds of the frame, larger and closer in a slightly heroic low-angle shot: three or four cheerful young Korean office workers in smart casual wear walking to work in the foreground, chest-up to waist-up, each holding a takeaway coffee cup, laughing and smiling at each other, faces clearly lit and readable. Behind them, filling the background so the place is instantly recognizable, the dense cluster of tall glass knowledge-industry office towers of Seoul's Gasan Digital Complex and a busy subway station exit with a crowd of commuters streaming out, bright morning sun with golden backlight, glowing rim light and lens flare, electric blue reflections on glass. A large Korean flag Taegukgi waving in sunlight high on the right, not covering the people or the buildings. The left third of the frame, smaller and further back, separated by a sharp diagonal seam: a colossal abandoned red-brick automobile factory in Detroit being torn apart by the steel claw of a demolition excavator, rusted window frames, dust particles and small debris in the air, cool grey-blue desaturated tones but bright daylight exposure, a small ordinary American flag in the top-left corner. No large central figure. Bright high-key daylight with lifted shadows, vivid saturated colors, split color accents of bright electric blue versus warm glowing orange, scratched and weathered textures on the Detroit side, triumphant atmosphere. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand marks anywhere, no real identifiable people. Avoid: night scene, dark, low-key, moody, crushed blacks, heavy vignette.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 한 장면 대비. 남아 있는 낡은 붉은 벽돌 공장 건물 바로 뒤로 솟은 거대한 유리 지식산업센터, 그 앞을 아침 출근 인파가 지나간다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic single-scene contrast, gritty high-clarity HDR photo with heavy micro-contrast, visible film grain, crisp detailed textures on brick, metal and glass. In the foreground stands a small weathered red-brick 1970s Korean factory building with scratched and weathered metal shutters and a rusted chimney, and directly behind it rises a towering modern glass office tower of Seoul's Guro Digital Complex catching bright morning sunlight with electric blue reflections and golden rim light. Between them a dense crowd of young Korean commuters in office wear walks to work, motion slightly blurred. Bright high-key daylight exposure with lifted shadows, dramatic volumetric clouds, vivid saturated colors, warm glowing orange brick versus bright electric blue glass. Strong sense of surprise that the factory land became an office city. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand marks anywhere, no real identifiable people. Avoid: night scene, dark, low-key, moody, crushed blacks, heavy vignette.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 변형 — 한 장면 대비형. 화면 왼쪽 절반은 잡초가 자란 디트로이트 공장 빈터와 반쯤 무너진 벽, 오른쪽 절반은 같은 시각 가산디지털단지역 출근 인파. 인물 없음.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic split-world single frame, gritty high-clarity HDR photo with heavy micro-contrast and visible film grain. The left half shows a vast empty lot in Detroit where a car factory once stood, tall weeds, broken concrete slabs and a half-demolished brick wall, dust particles in the air, cool desaturated tones but bright daylight exposure. The right half shows the same morning hour in Seoul's Gasan Digital Complex, a packed crowd of commuters pouring out of a subway exit under gleaming glass towers with warm golden backlight and lens flare. The two halves meet at a sharp diagonal seam. Bright high-key daylight, vivid saturated colors, split color accents of bright electric blue versus warm glowing orange, scratched and weathered textures on the Detroit side. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand marks anywhere, no real identifiable people. Avoid: night scene, dark, low-key, moody, crushed blacks, heavy vignette.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 실물 클로즈업 — 1970년대 구로공단 미싱(재봉틀) 한 대를 크게, 그 뒤로 흐릿하게 지금의 유리 빌딩 사무실 창. 옆에 익명의 60대 한국 여성이 미싱을 바라본다. 컬러, 흑백 금지.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic object close-up, gritty high-clarity HDR photo with heavy micro-contrast, visible film grain and crisp detailed textures on metal. A vintage 1970s Korean industrial sewing machine, scratched and weathered black and gold metal, fills more than half of the frame in sharp focus on a worn wooden table, with a few colorful fabric scraps. Beside it an attractive likeable Korean woman in her 60s with a warm face looks at the machine with a nostalgic, moved expression. In the softly blurred background, a bright modern glass office window of a Seoul digital complex with electric blue reflections and warm golden sunlight. Full color, bright high-key daylight exposure, vivid saturated colors, never black and white or sepia. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand marks anywhere, no real identifiable people. Avoid: night scene, dark, low-key, moody, crushed blacks, heavy vignette.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드 — 단면 컷어웨이. 한 필지 위의 지식산업센터 빌딩을 잘라 층마다 다른 회사(코딩하는 개발자, 영상 편집실, 작은 제조 작업장)가 들어찬 내부를 보여 주고, 빌딩 아래 땅에는 옛 공장 바닥 흔적.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic detailed cutaway cross-section view revealing the interior of a modern Korean knowledge industry center tower on a former factory site, gritty high-clarity HDR photo look with micro-contrast and fine grain. Each floor is a different small company: software developers at glowing monitors, a video editing studio, a game design team, a compact clean manufacturing workshop, all busy in bright light. At ground level the cut reveals old factory floor concrete and rusted rail tracks of a 1970s plant beneath the new tower. Bright high-key daylight, vivid saturated colors, electric blue screens versus warm orange interior lights, crisp detailed textures. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand marks anywhere, no real identifiable people. Avoid: night scene, dark, low-key, moody, crushed blacks, heavy vignette.
